Customer Care Specialist
description:
Making preventive health the default for every human in Europe

 

The mission

At Lucis, we believe healthcare should be preventive, not reactive. We’re building the OS for human longevity to help people add more healthy years to their lives. You can read more about who we are and how we work here.

 

The role

Health is complex, personal, and deeply important to our members. As the voice of Lucis clients, you support them throughout their health journey and own member happiness end to end.

With rapid member growth, we are hiring our first dedicated Customer Care Team Lead. You will own the member experience end-to-end, stabilize our operational metrics, and build and manage a world-class support team.

What you will own

  • Member support: Resolve member and lab partner inquiries via chat, email and phone, with warmth, precision and a sense of urgency.

  • Phone-first when it matters: Pick up the phone whenever a situation calls for a human voice: a delayed result, a stressful moment, a confused member.

  • Know your boundaries: Work hand in hand with our medical team and know exactly when to escalate a health question rather than answer it yourself.

  • Voice of the member: Spot recurring issues and turn them into clear, structured feedback for the product and ops teams.

  • Contribute to projects: Take part in initiatives that improve the member experience, like rebuilding our Help Center, designing proactive care for lab delays, or automating repetitive workflows with AI.

 

About you

You’re passionate about the future of human health and want your work to help people stay healthy for longer. You move quickly from idea to execution, take full ownership of what you build, and work best with talented people who care as much as you do.

You thrive in fast‑moving environments, learn by doing, and value feedback as a way to continuously improve. You use AI the way others use a calculator: naturally, to go faster and think bigger.

 

You’ll fit in well if

  • Experience: 1+ years in B2C customer care, support, hospitality, or any role where you dealt directly with customers. Strong recent graduates with relevant experience are welcome too.

  • Bilingual: Fluent in both English and French, written and spoken.

  • People-first energy: You bring genuine warmth and empathy to every interaction, and you turn routine support into memorable experiences.

  • Rigorous precision: Exceptional attention to detail, with zero tolerance for misquotes, wrong information or operational errors. In health, accuracy is care.

  • Builder mindset: When something breaks twice, your instinct is to fix the root cause, not just the ticket.

Nice to have

  • Support tooling: You've used Intercom or similar support tools.

  • AI automation: You've already used AI tools to automate part of your work.

  • Startup mindset: You thrive in early-stage environments with high autonomy, rapid execution and clear communication.

 

The process

  • Intro call, culture & role fit (20 min)

  • Case study interview (30-60 min)

  • Deep dive and team chat, on-site (2 hours)

  • Reference calls

How we work

We work together from our Paris hub. We’re passionate about what we’re building and believe the fastest way to create something exceptional is side by side. We’re open to relocation support for the right individuals, and we welcome missionaries who travel to work with us in Paris on a regular basis.

  • Rigor without ego: Audits, science, and code all deserve the same high bar.

  • Radical ownership: Feedback loops are short; everyone contributes to building the best version of Lucis.

  • Velocity over perfection: We ship daily and prefer a good decision today over a perfect one next week.

title: Icarus Digital Marketing: Performance Creative Strategist and AI Producer
description: Headquarters: United States URL: https://icarusdigitalmarketing.com/ Performance Creative Strategist and AI Producer Remote | Full time | Paid 30-day working trial Icarus Digital Marketing builds and scales direct-response ecommerce brands, including brands in difficult and restricted categories. We are hiring a hands-on performance creative operator to work directly with the owners on our internal portfolio of brands. This is not a conventional graphic-design role. We need someone who understands why Meta ads convert and can personally turn that understanding into high-quality static and video creative using current AI production tools. You may come from dropshipping, affiliate marketing, DTC, a performance agency, or a creative media-buying background. We care more about commercial judgment, production ability, speed, and proof of work than polished credentials. The work You will use and help improve our internal Creative Cockpit. It takes a brand from research and foundational strategy through campaign creation, production, review, and delivery. For each brand, the system holds brand assets and voice, customer language and audience psychology, pains and desires, necessary beliefs, competitor intelligence, awareness levels, angles, hooks, offer context, prior creative, winners, and performance signals. Your job is to turn that intelligence into creative that can sell. • Read campaign briefs, audience research, voice-of-customer material, and brand strategy documents. • Decide what each batch should test and why. • Source and analyse strong visual and structural references. • Develop angles, hooks, scripts, concepts, storyboards, and landing-page direction. • Personally produce static ads and short-form video ads. • Use AI image, video, voice, and editing tools at a high level. • Create meaningful variants without producing repetitive AI slop. • Review work for persuasion, visual quality, brand fit, platform fit, and compliance. • Refine weak generations rather than accepting the first output. • Package approved assets for launch and document what each concept tests. • Read results and use the learning to plan the next batch. What you must be good at • Direct-response advertising and Meta creative strategy • Audience psychology and voice-of-customer interpretation • Awareness levels, hooks, angles, mechanisms, objections, offers, and message-market fit • Understanding when an ad should lead to a PDP, advertorial, listicle, quiz, or sales page • Static ad, UGC, and short-form video production • Visual-reference analysis and controlled recreation • Current AI image and video workflows using tools such as Seedance, Google Flow/Omni, Nano Banana/Gemini, GPT Image, Higgsfield, Kling, Sora, Veo, or comparable tools • Editing, compositing, pacing, captions, sound, and final polish • Fast, organised batch production • Reading creative performance and choosing the next test You are probably not right for this role if • Your portfolio is mostly branding, organic social content, or attractive design without performance context. • You call every asset “scroll-stopping” but cannot explain the audience belief or conversion mechanism. • You are a strategist who depends on other people to make the work. • You are a tool operator who needs someone else to provide every hook, angle, script, and decision. • You use one prompt, accept the first output, and call it AI production. • You cannot show exactly what you personally contributed to portfolio examples. • You dislike volume, iteration, testing, or direct feedback. What success looks like Within 30 days, you can understand our strategy packs and operating system, take a structured brief from research to finished assets with limited supervision, produce a useful weekly mix of static and video concepts, explain the reason for every important decision, maintain quality while moving quickly, and suggest practical improvements to the workflow. Compensation The role begins with a fully paid 30-day working trial at USD $2,000 . If the fit is strong, it becomes a long-term full-time position expected to pay USD $2,000 to $3,000 per month , based on demonstrated level, with additional performance upside available for an exceptional long-term operator. We care about ability, English comprehension, reliability, some overlap with our working hours, and quality of output. How to apply Do not send a generic cover letter. Message Simon on WhatsApp at +353 86 349 5073 and begin with: I make the work. • Send three Meta ads you personally made or materially directed. • For each example, state exactly what you did and explain the audience, angle, hook, and intended next step in the funnel. • Share any useful performance context you are permitted to disclose. Redacted evidence is acceptable. • Show one weak or failed creative and explain what you learned or changed. • List the AI tools you use in real production and explain your normal workflow from reference to finished asset. • Send a Loom of no more than five minutes. Choose one Meta ad you respect, explain why it works, and describe the next three variants you would test. • State your location, timezone, availability, and expected monthly compensation after the trial. Applications without the requested evidence will not be reviewed. Shortlisted candidates will complete a small paid practical exercise before the 30-day trial. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/icarus-digital-marketing-performance-creative-strategist-and-ai-producer

title: Fraud Investigator (Crypto)
description:
💰 £25k-£60k, depending on experience and location

📍 UK / Europe / Remote

Fanvue is one of the fastest-growing creator monetisation platforms globally. We're an AI-powered, creator-first platform helping creators connect, engage, and earn directly from their audiences at scale. Fanvue has surpassed $200m+ in annual recurring revenue, with triple-digit year-on-year growth, supporting hundreds of thousands of creators and millions of fans worldwide.

As crypto usage on Fanvue's payment rails keeps growing, so does our exposure to crypto-specific fraud and financial crime. Recent cases have shown gaps in the Fraud team's crypto knowledge, and right now nobody on the team has dedicated crypto fraud or financial crime expertise. This role exists to build that capability from the ground up.

🎯 The Role

We're hiring Fanvue's first Fraud Investigator with dedicated crypto expertise, reporting to Head of Fraud. AI has taken our fraud detection as far as it can on crypto rails, what's missing is in-house subject matter expertise: someone who has used these investigation tools before, can set the strategy, and can train the rest of the team.

🚀 What You'll Do

  • Lead on investigating cases of potential fraud or financial crime where crypto rails are involved, including payment fraud, account takeover, and money laundering typologies on crypto on/off-ramps

  • Build out crypto-specific fraud investigation capability within the Fraud team: on-chain tracing methods, tooling, and documented process for crypto-related cases

  • Train the wider Fraud team on crypto fraud red flags and typologies, so risk indicators get caught earlier in standard triage, not just by you

  • Design how Fanvue prevents and detects crypto-related fraud and financial crime as the function matures

  • Work directly with vendors to get the most out of crypto investigation tooling and data

  • Support fraud and financial crime investigations where crypto isn't involved, as part of the wider Fraud team's caseload

  • Lead on escalations to law enforcement where relevant

  • Feed your expertise into loss prevention strategy across Fraud, product, and payments

👀 Who You Are

  • 3+ years investigating fraud and/or financial crime with specific crypto/blockchain exposure, from an exchange, blockchain analytics firm, bank crypto desk, or law enforcement crypto unit

  • A process creator and improver: you've played a role in designing or improving investigation techniques, not just following them

  • Comfortable being the subject matter expert. As our first crypto-focused Fraud hire, you'll build the wider team's knowledge while acting as the go-to for other parts of the business (payments, payouts, product) wherever crypto risk shows up

  • Familiar with crypto investigation tooling (e.g. Chainalysis, TRM Labs, Elliptic, etc.) and know how to get the most from it in a fraud prevention context

  • High ownership: excited by a large, expanding remit, and not afraid to break new ground without an existing playbook

✨ You'll Thrive Here If

  • You want to build a function from scratch rather than inherit one

  • You're energised by being the go-to expert and enjoy teaching others what you know

  • You like combining hands-on casework with process and systems design

  • You're comfortable working across functions, Fraud, product, payments, to get crypto risk taken seriously

⚠️ You'll Struggle Here If

  • You need an established playbook, team, or tooling already in place before you can be effective

  • You'd rather stay purely hands-on and not upskill others

  • You're not comfortable being the sole specialist accountable for a new risk area

🌍 Why Join Fanvue?

  • Sunday Times Best Places to Work, two years running. We don't just say we have great culture, we prove it

  • A genuine greenfield opportunity: build Fanvue's first in-house crypto fraud capability from scratch

  • Direct exposure across Fraud, Payments, and Product as crypto usage grows

  • AI-native: we are not bolting AI on, it's core to our product and how we work

  • Remote-friendly across UK/Europe

  • High annual leave flexibility

  • Support with upskilling and development costs

  • Benefits package including gym memberships, apps, and more we're actively building out

⭐ Fanvue is for Everyone

We know that diverse teams build better products. Even if you do not meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. Potential, mindset, and ambition matter just as much as experience.

title: Stage AI & Automatisering | Amsterdam hbo/wo
description:
Wat ga je doen?

Binnen Flagship Amsterdam zijn we volop bezig om met AI en automatisering ons werk slimmer en makkelijker te maken. Daar kunnen we jouw hulp goed bij gebruiken! Als stagiair AI & Automatisering ben je de rechterhand van de specialist voor IT en automatisering. Je onderzoekt bestaande processen, denkt mee over verbeteringen en helpt bij het ontwikkelen van nieuwe tools. Je krijgt veel ruimte om zelf ideeën uit te werken en leert tijdens deze stage ontzettend veel over AI, technologie en automatisering.

Wat ga je leren?

  • AI en automatisering inzetten in de praktijk;

  • Zelf slimme tools en oplossingen ontwikkelen;

  • Bestaande processen verbeteren en efficiënter maken;

  • Werken met verschillende AI-tools en technologieën;

  • Ervaring opdoen met echte projecten binnen een groeiend bedrijf;

  • Je eigen ideeën uitwerken en veel nieuwe vaardigheden ontwikkelen.

Praktisch

Startdatum: in overleg;

Beschikbaarheid: 3–5 dagen per week, in te richten rond je studierooster;

Locatie: kantoor in hartje Amsterdam;

Stagevergoeding: €500 per maand bij 5 dagen per week.

Dit bieden wij

  • Een uitdagende en leerzame stage waarin je écht meedraait in het team;

  • Intensieve begeleiding door een ervaren IT-specialist, met ruimte voor persoonlijke en professionele ontwikkeling;

  • Een centraal gelegen kantoor op ca. 15 minuten lopen van Amsterdam Centraal;

  • Een gezellige werksfeer en een heerlijke, verzorgde lunch op kantoor;

  • Legendarische vrijdagmiddagborrels, sportieve uitjes en bedrijfsfeesten;

  • 25% personeelskorting op rondvaarten en andere activiteiten binnen Flagship Holding;

  • De mogelijkheid om je stage af te sluiten met een concrete showcase- of portfolio-project.

Functievereisten

  • Je volgt een HBO- of WO-opleiding in bijvoorbeeld AI, ICT, Informatica, Business IT of een vergelijkbare richting;

  • Ervaring met API-koppelingen en databases is mooi meegenomen;

  • Je hebt basiskennis van programmeren en vindt het leuk om hierin verder te leren;

  • Zelfstandig werken gaat je goed af en je neemt graag zelf initiatief;

  • Je kunt goed communiceren in het Engels, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.


Over Flagship

Flagship Amsterdam is een jonge en snelgroeiende rederij in het hart van Amsterdam. Wat in 2017 begon met drie boten, is inmiddels uitgegroeid tot een vloot van meer dan 70 boten, en we groeien nog steeds elke dag verder! Jaarlijks verwelkomen we gasten uit meer dan 55 verschillende landen, en we varen het hele jaar door. Dit doen we met een gedreven en ambitieus team van meer dan 800 (seizoensgebonden) medewerkers.

Maar Flagship is meer dan alleen rondvaarten. Vanuit dezelfde energie bouwen we aan verschillende concepten die allemaal draaien om beleving, gastvrijheid en de stad Amsterdam. Zo ontdek je de stad op de fiets met Flagship Bike Tours, proef je de sfeer bij Flagship Waffle Experience Amsterdam, en werken we bij Shipyard aan unieke events en creatieve projecten op en rond het water. Daarnaast hebben we labels zoals Voyage Amsterdam, Captain Jack en Aemstelland, elk met hun eigen stijl en doelgroep. Samen vormen ze één organisatie, maar met verschillende manieren om mensen de stad te laten ervaren.

title: Data & AI Consultant
description:
Ben jij de consultant die niet alleen adviseert, maar ook daadwerkelijk de leiding neemt over de uitvoering? Die precies weet hoe een modern data platform eruitziet, welke architectuurkeuzes ertoe doen en hoe je een klant overtuigt om de juiste koers te varen? Dan zoeken wij jou.

Bij BigData Republic bouwen we aan de data- en AI-ambities van toonaangevende organisaties. We zijn AI-native en combineren dit met diepgaande engineering kennis. Op deze manier bieden wij onze klanten technische begeleiding tot duurzame en innovatieve oplossingen. Als Data & AI Consultant ben jij de schakel tussen strategische visie en hands-on realisatie, een rol die we nu voor het eerst toevoegen aan ons team.



Wat ga je doen?

Je werkt bij onze klanten op het snijvlak van strategie en technologie. Je bent geen consultant die alleen analyseert en dat tot slides verwerkt. Jij hebt de regie van A tot Z, van hulpvraag tot en met implementatie. Je analyseert- en vertaalt de wensen van onze partners naar technisch elegante oplossingen, van platform engineering tot MLOps en AI implementatie. Vervolgens begeleid je de teams bij onze klanten die dit in productie brengen.

  • Je vertaalt business-uitdagingen naar concrete data- en AI-strategieën en maakt dit inzichtelijk voor zowel C-level als engineering teams.

  • Je adviseert over data-architecturen, platformen en technologiekeuzes (cloud, lakehouse, real-time, batch) en bent in staat dit inhoudelijk te verdedigen.

  • Je leidt de implementatie: je stuurt data engineers en scientists aan, bewaakt de kwaliteit en houdt de grote lijn in het oog.

Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar ervaring in een data-gerelateerde rol, waarvan minimaal 3 jaar in een consultancy- of leidende positie.

BigData Republic is een high-end consultancybureau gespecialiseerd in data science, data engineering en machine learning. We zijn AI-native en combineren dit met diepgaande engineering kennis. description: About Toptal Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe , Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce . We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold. Job Summary: As an Enterprise Sales Executive at Toptal, you will be a key driver of growth within our AI Solutions business. In this role, you will identify, develop, and close opportunities with enterprise clients by helping them solve complex business challenges through forward-deployed AI solutions, AI software and platforms, AI services, and AI-enabled transformation. You will develop tailored solutions that help clients move from AI strategy and experimentation into production, combining Toptal’s capabilities across AI Strategy & Transformation, Agentic Solutions, Data Services, AI Platforms, Industry Solutions, Joint Partner Solutions, and Managed Services to achieve measurable business outcomes. This role is designed for true hunters who thrive in a high-performance, client-facing environment. Success in this role is measured by your ability to convert new enterprise relationships into durable revenue and establish Toptal as a core AI services provider embedded in your clients’ most critical initiatives. Enterprise AI has shifted rapidly from experimentation to execution. Companies are investing in models, agents, AI platforms, data infrastructure, and AI-enabled applications, but many are struggling to translate those investments into production systems and measurable business outcomes. The challenge is no longer simply selecting an AI model or platform. Enterprises must identify the right workflows, connect AI to their proprietary data and knowledge, integrate existing systems, build and deploy agents and applications, establish evaluation and control frameworks, drive adoption, and continuously operate and improve AI in production. Toptal brings together world-class AI and domain talent, forward-deployed solution delivery, AI platforms and capabilities, strategic technology partners, expert-in-the-loop operations, and managed services to help enterprises move from AI promise to production. This role exists to convert that market opportunity into new enterprise relationships and position Toptal as a strategic partner for companies deploying AI across their organizations. This is a remote position with significant client-facing fieldwork across the US. Applicants who reside within commutable distance of a major metropolitan area are strongly preferred. title: Risk Operations Analyst
description:
About Ryft

 

Ryft is a regulated payment facilitator and authorised payment institution building the infrastructure layer for modern commerce platforms.

We enable marketplaces, SaaS platforms and multi-party ecosystems to embed and monetise payments natively. Our technology handles onboarding, compliance, orchestration, split payments and revenue sharing, allowing our partners to focus on growth while we manage complexity.

 

We are now entering the next phase of scale, expanding into new verticals and building a category-defining embedded payments platform.

 

About the Role

We’re hiring a Risk Operations Analyst to sit within our first line fraud and risk function, reporting to the Fraud & Risk Manager. This role is the operational backbone of how Ryft manages its relationships with acquiring and banking partners, taking inbound queries from our acquires and bank partners and owning them through to resolution.

The core of this role is investigative. When a query comes in from a banking partner, we need someone who can trace a transaction end-to-end through our systems, understand what the bank is actually asking, produce a response that meets their expectations, and critically, question what they find along the way rather than closing the thread at the first plausible answer.

Alongside partner queries, you’ll carry out merchant risk monitoring as part of the broader fraud and risk operation; reviewing merchant behaviour, flagging anomalies, and feeding intelligence into the fraud detection and response process led by the Fraud & Risk Manager. If you’re someone who digs until they have the full picture, is comfortable navigating between internal systems and external expectations, and takes pride in the quality of what they send to a bank, this role is for you.

What You’ll Do

Acquirer & Banking Partner Query Management

• Act as the primary point of contact for inbound risk and compliance queries from Ryft’s

acquiring and banking partners — managing each query through to full resolution.

• Trace transactions end-to-end through Ryft’s systems in response to partner queries —

reconstructing the payment journey, identifying where issues occurred, and producing clear, accurate responses that meet the bank’s expectations.

• Understand what each banking partner needs to see in a response and tailor your output

accordingly — whether that’s a transaction trail, a merchant explanation, supporting documentation, or a combination.

• Question what you find — don’t close a query at the first plausible answer. If something looks unusual or doesn’t add up, dig further and escalate to the Fraud & Risk Manager where needed.

• Maintain a clear log of all partner queries, response timelines, and outcomes, ensuring

nothing falls through the cracks and that patterns across queries are surfaced proactively.

• Build a working knowledge of each partner’s reporting expectations, query formats, and

escalation preferences, reducing friction in ongoing communications.

Merchant Risk Monitoring

• Carry out day-to-day merchant risk monitoring across the Ryft portfolio — reviewing

transaction activity, volumes, and behavioural patterns to identify anomalies that may indicate fraud, policy breach, or elevated risk.

• Feed merchant risk intelligence into the fraud detection and response process, working

closely with the Fraud & Risk Manager to ensure monitoring activity informs rule tuning and threshold decisions.

• Flag merchants or sub-merchants exhibiting patterns of concern, documenting your findings clearly and escalating where a risk response is required.

• Support chargeback and dispute monitoring at the merchant level, identifying accounts with elevated dispute rates and feeding that data into the wider fraud analysis process.

• Maintain accurate, audit-ready records of monitoring activity and risk decisions in line with FCA expectations and internal policy.

Cross-functional Collaboration

• Work closely with the Fraud & Risk Manager to ensure partner query intelligence and merchant monitoring findings are connected — a query from an acquirer about a specific merchant should inform, and be informed by, what you’re seeing in monitoring.

• Liaise with the underwriting team where partner queries or merchant monitoring activity raises questions about how a merchant was onboarded or what their risk profile should be.

• Support the engineering and product teams with information requests related to transaction tracing, where system-level investigation requires cross-functional input.

• Contribute to the continuous improvement of response templates, internal runbooks, and query management procedures.

What We’re Looking For

Essential

acquirer, payment facilitator, or bank — with direct exposure to acquirer or banking partner

queries.

• Strong written communication skills, with experience producing clear, structured responses to banking or regulatory counterparties who expect precision.

• An investigative mindset — you ask the next question, not just the obvious one. You’re not satisfied with a plausible explanation if the evidence doesn’t fully support it.

• Organised and reliable under query volume — able to manage multiple open cases

simultaneously without losing track of timelines or detail.

• Comfortable operating within a first line risk function with real accountability for the quality and timeliness of outputs.

Nice to Have

title: Laboratory Technician, Lab Operations
description:
Adaptyv is building an automated lab that lets AI agents run biology experiments.

We're entering the era of agentic science where AI models can now design novel proteins, propose hypotheses, and iterate on experimental results. But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world.

We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today.

Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development.

We’re growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation.

About the Role

Our lab in Lausanne runs thousands of constructs a week through automated workcells, liquid handlers, and binding instruments. That only works if the instruments are calibrated, the buffers are made, the stock is where the system says it is, and the bench is ready when the scientists arrive. You are the person who makes sure it is.

You'll own the day-to-day upkeep of our automation and instruments, run buffer and reagent production, keep the lab clean, safe, and stocked, and lead the rollout of new inventory management and lab operations processes across the lab. This is a hands-on, in-the-lab role, working closely with our Lab Manager, the Lab Operations team, and the scientists whose experiments depend on you getting it right.

What You'll Do

  • Run daily and weekly calibration of our Hamilton liquid handling systems.

  • Calibrate and maintain key instruments, including the Echo and pH meters.

  • Look after the SPR system: buffer bottle changes, rinsing, and routine upkeep.

  • Take ownership of our automated workcells and keep them clean, organized, and calibrated.

  • Prepare buffers, reagents, and reaction mixes according to established SOPs. Run weekly buffer production and handle ad-hoc requests from the team.

  • Lead the rollout of new inventory management and lab operations processes across the lab, and help design and improve them as the lab scales.

  • Organize fridges and storage, run inventory, and keep consumables, glassware, and bench supplies stocked so experiments never stall.

  • Keep benches and shared spaces clean, clear, and ready for work every day.

  • Manage hazardous and biohazardous waste disposal (including broken glass and sharps), waste sorting, recycling, and general waste removal in line with safety regulations.

  • Run the lab dishwasher and make sure clean glassware is always available.

  • Plan and document scheduled deep cleans and preventive maintenance.

What We're Looking For

  • Laboratory apprenticeship (CFC Laborant/in), BSc in a relevant field, or an equivalent lab technician qualification.

  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

  • Precision in following and executing protocols and SOPs.

  • A service mindset. You enjoy making other people's work easier.

  • Comfortable with routine, with an eye for ways to improve it.

  • Calm and reliable in a fast-paced, high-throughput environment.

  • Experience with lab automation or liquid handling systems (Hamilton, Echo, or similar) is a plus.

  • Experience with inventory or LIMS tools is a plus.

  • Proficiency in English and French is a plus. Many of our vendors and delivery services operate in French.

Details

  • Location: Lausanne, Switzerland (on-site)

  • Type: Full time

  • Start date: ASAP

We review applications on a rolling basis.

Application deadline

We are reviewing applicants on a rolling basis.
